name: ShipSwift
summary: AI solutions studio and home of ShipSwift, its open-source SwiftUI component library with full-stack recipes.
description: ShipSwift builds and runs custom AI systems and software for enterprises — AI agents, computer vision, data pipelines and iOS/web apps — on ShipSwift, its open-source MIT SwiftUI component library: 80+ components and modules plus full-stack recipes delivered to AI coding agents through skills and an MCP recipe server. The site also showcases the products Signer Labs ships and operates.
